entries.subject: Radar data from Goldstone DSS-14
entries.finding: Goldstone's asteroid radar observations reach this repository through NASA's PDS Small Bodies Node rather than an observatory archive; the PDS search API answered on 2026-09-17 (200). Shape models derived from its radar are already used for several asteroids.
entries.revisitWhen: A body or star in this repository needs data from this facility.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: PDS data carry no restrictions on use; the specific product licences were not re-checked here.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed to publish a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software for this facility
entries.finding: Radar shape models are delivered as finished products; no reduction software is run here.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
